_comment: Owners file of push PP-C (find a plant, know a plant; plus the palette-page fixes of the mock-up conformance report) of the Consortium v2 plan (knowledge/project/plant-palette-slices.md section 3, rewritten 2026-11-17 from .local/consortium/v2/ppc/design-check-c1.md, design-check-c2.md and conformance/report.md, citations at master f102922, corrected the same day by the amendment check .local/consortium/v2/ppc/amendment-check.md, 23 findings). Path -> stream per chunk: one owner per path per chunk; a path may change hands between chunks (store.ts main -> c2 -> pf; verdict-line.ts main -> c2 -> pf; kit/fit.tsx c2 -> pf; App.tsx c2 -> pf; PoolSlot.tsx c2 -> pf; views/palette/** main/c2 -> pf; views/kit/sheet.tsx and Sheets.tsx main -> c1; sqlite-source.ts and source.ts main -> c1; consortium-pp-b2.browser.test.mjs main -> c1 -> pf (c2's :441 range case handed to c1 through the coordinator); consortium-p5-s5c, -e6 browser and consortium-p5-seams main -> c2; consortium-pp-b1, -seams-layout and -seams-p2 browser main -> c1 -> pf, -seams-p5 browser main -> c1 (coordinator, 2026-11-17: c1's Find breaks their Add and Paste cases, pf's Place and palette rework the rest); the role files main -> c2 -> main). Patterns are repo-relative: '*' stays within a folder, '**' crosses folders. Chunks run in order; streams inside a chunk run in parallel (at most two building agents). Streams by feature: c1 Find (chunk 1), c2 One plant (chunk 1), pf the palette-page and Place fixes (chunk 2, after c1 and c2 merge; no early start). Commit 0 (chunk 0) deletes the Add sheet, list-query, jobFind and P5-14e first (owner rule 'Delete first'), writes the final role table (find matches views/find/** and views/Paste.tsx, so c1 needs no role change), keeps the reader accepting schema 3 and 4, and moves the 11 PP-C markers from parked to moved (plan-owners.test.mjs widened to PP-C). v14 split (2026-11-18, .local/consortium/v2/ppc/pf/v14-spec-update.md section 1): chunk 2 keeps pf-a, pf-b, pf-c with v14 duties; chunk 3 is new (pf-d 'Your place in figures', pf-e 'Many plants', pf-f 'One plant'; at most two building, pf-f third or first if a slot is free); the old chunk 3 (main) is chunk 4. pf commit 0W (main agent, before chunk 2) lands the shared seams and rulings R1 to R4 in files no stream owns. Chunk 4 main opens with 0b, the install of the published schema-4 export (real-data figures, weigh.json APG family cases, vectors), before the hand-offs. 'shared' lists the locale files: each listed stream adds keys only under its own prefix and changes or deletes only the keys its edits name; the merge agent joins the blocks. node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check <chunk> <stream> <base> --file scripts/plan/pp-c-owners.json fails a stream diff outside its rows. A file found needed mid-build is requested from the main agent, never taken. No backward compatibility work (owner, 2026-11-17): main deletes in commit 0 the beta tool's older-version paths and their keys consortium.share.outdated, consortium.share.pasted.outdated and consortium.start.oldSave (listed in main's edits); no stream adds alias or old-format handling.
step: consortium-v2 Plant palette redesign, push PP-C

The lines: Climate (Coldest nights, Hottest days, Rain a year, Dry months in a row; three periods each), Water (Watering), Soil (Soil pH, The ground after heavy rain, Pots or brought-in soil), 'After release' (closed, opening to the board's two paragraphs), 'Not asked, and why', 'What it means for your choice'.
